_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for council config. Route by task fit and benchmark evidence, not by a cost chain. Edit here, then run council_config_sync when derived council docs change. Known CLIs keep built-in argv branches; optional argv overrides remain supported.

clau.label: ClauC
clau.role: Judgement and scoped bug-fix on existing code with a narrow evidence pack. Master dev only when the same issue has failed council retry more than 2 times. MCP only for explicit T4/runtime/DOM/CDP/browser stateful work. Not for broad scan/read/context gathering or new-code creation.
clau.cli_channel: claude --print --model claude-opus-4-8 -p "<prompt>"  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_clau.txt]

codo.label: CodoC
codo.role: High-end council worker fixed to GPT-5.6 Sol: judgement, independent audit, high-difficulty development, code building, plan drafting, and final conflict resolution. CodoC is not the default leader and is not for broad evidence scans.
codo.cli_channel: codex exec --ephemeral --model gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --skip-git-repo-check "<prompt>"  [uses the active user CODEX_HOME/config; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_codo.txt]

kilo.label: KiloC
kilo.role: Most stable basic harness observed. Default cost-effective route: ltnai/minimax-m3 for routine implementation reasoning, backend operational design, recovery, lease/fencing and bounded code work. Qwen for secondary logic review. DeepSeek only for narrow scans, not sole long-horizon design. Kimi K3 default-off; GPT-5.6 Sol unavailable in curated list.
kilo.cli_channel: kilo run "<prompt>" --model ltnai/glm-5.2 --format json --dangerously-skip-permissions  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_kilo.txt; cwd set by subprocess not --dir]

pic.label: PiC
pic.role: Benchmark-calibrated multi-model Pi harness. Primary: qwen3.7-max for complex logic/conflict/durable design. DeepSeek V4 Pro for cheap adversarial bug/edge scans. MiniMax M3 for alternate brainstorm/frontend review. GPT-5.6 Sol is available but expensive. Kimi K3 is DEFAULT-OFF after Round 0 transport failure.
pic.cli_channel: pi --print --no-session --approve --provider <provider> --model <model> --thinking high "<prompt>"  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_pic.txt]

ope.label: OpeC
ope.role: Benchmark-calibrated OpenCode harness. Primary: openai-compatible/qwen3.7-max for operational, migration and observability review. DeepSeek V4 Pro for bounded evidence/bug scans. MiniMax M3 for cheap alternate review. Kimi K3 and GPT-5.6 Sol are not default routes.
ope.cli_channel: opencode run "<prompt>" --model <model> --thinking --dangerously-skip-permissions  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_ope.txt]

hermes.label: HermC
hermes.role: Benchmark-calibrated Hermes harness. Use MiniMax M3 for bounded alternate failure-mode/frontend review; Qwen for secondary logic review; DeepSeek for evidence/bug scans. Harness has higher integration fragility. Kimi K3 is DEFAULT-OFF after HTTP 400; GPT-5.6 Sol unavailable in curated list.
hermes.cli_channel: hermes chat -q "<prompt>" --yolo -t web,file [-m <model>] [--provider <prov>] [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_hermes.txt]

gro.label: GroC
gro.role: Grok CLI worker on LTNAI provider model xAI-grok-4.6-build. Grok-native reasoning plus loaded design/bugs-scan/code skills. Dispatch via council_message.
gro.cli_channel: C:\Users\ADMIN\.grok\bin\grok.exe -p "<prompt>" -m xAI-grok-4.6-build --yolo  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_gro.txt]

coordination_rule: The user-triggered desktop/current CA that loads leader-council-skill is the temporary leader; no CA identity is hard-coded as leader. Classify RISK_LEVEL and DEV_LEVEL before routing. Low-risk/low-dev may use KiloC+MiniMax for routine work or PiC+DeepSeek for bounded read-only scans. Mid-risk requires an independent reviewer. High-risk work requires PiC+Qwen design, CodoC independent high-end audit/judgement/high-dev, and OpeC+Qwen operational review as applicable; DeepSeek/MiniMax are never sole authority. CodoC is a worker route, not leader by default. No cost chain.
parallelism_rule: The current leader CA may dispatch independent tasks in parallel when output ownership is disjoint. Serialize overlapping writes. RISK_LEVEL and DEV_LEVEL set the verification floor; high-risk shards require independent high-end review regardless of dev difficulty.
mission: Route by task fit plus RISK_LEVEL x DEV_LEVEL. Low/low: routine bounded route. Mid risk: independent reviewer. High risk: PiC+Qwen design, CodoC independent audit/judgement/high-dev, OpeC+Qwen operational review; cheap models evidence-only. CodoC is a worker, ClauC exceptional-only, no cost chain.
guardrail_harness_rule: The current CA reading leader-council-skill is leader. Classify RISK_LEVEL and DEV_LEVEL before exact harness+model routing. High-risk work cannot use DeepSeek/MiniMax as sole authority. CodoC is the high-end judgement/audit/high-dev worker, not a hard-coded leader.

task_routing.complex_logic / conflict_analysis / arch: PiC + qwen3.7-max primary design. KiloC + minimax-m3 cross-checks recovery. CodoC + gpt-5.6-sol provides high-end judgement or resolves high-risk conflicts.
task_routing.routine_implementation / backend_operati: KiloC + ltnai/minimax-m3 default cost-effective route; verify long-horizon gaps when risk is high.
task_routing.bug_scan / edge_cases / adversarial_revi: PiC + deepseek-v4-pro primary cheap adversarial scanner. OpeC/HermC + DeepSeek may take bounded independent evidence shards. KiloC+DeepSeek is last scan fallback, never sole design authority.
task_routing.brainstorm / frontend_ui / alternate_fai: PiC + minimax-m3 or HermC + minimax-m3; HermC remains secondary due harness fragility.
task_routing.code_builder / plan_drafter / final_conf: CodoC + gpt-5.6-sol for difficult code building, plan drafting, judgement and final conflict resolution; worker route, not default leader; avoid broad scans.
task_routing.kimi_k3: DEFAULT_OFF_BENCHMARK_FAILED for PiC/HermC/OpeC/KiloC until transport/provider repair and fresh Round 0 PASS.
task_routing.gpt_5_6_on_switchable_harness: PiC only is currently verified; HermC/OpeC/KiloC unavailable until curated lists and Round 0 pass.
task_routing.T4_runtime_DOM_browser: ClauC only when explicit stateful T4/MCP is required; exceptional route outside normal routing order.
task_routing.independent_audit / high_dev / judgement: CodoC + gpt-5.6-sol for evidence-based independent audit, high-difficulty development and high-stakes judgement.
task_routing.risk_low / dev_low: KiloC+MiniMax for routine bounded implementation; PiC+DeepSeek for read-only adversarial scan; leader/[A] verifies reversible output.
task_routing.risk_mid / dev_low_mid: PiC+Qwen when logic changes; KiloC+MiniMax implementation; at least one independent reviewer, normally OpeC+Qwen for operations.
task_routing.risk_mid / dev_high: PiC+Qwen design + CodoC high-dev/judgement; OpeC+Qwen operations review; cross-verify before merge.
task_routing.risk_high / any_dev: PiC+Qwen design, CodoC independent high-end audit/judgement/high-dev, OpeC+Qwen operational review; explicit human/mission gate, rollback and failure tests; DeepSeek/MiniMax evidence-only.

stale_memory_corrections: Pre-benchmark model-only mission routing is obsolete as default; route by harness+model.
Kimi K3 is DEFAULT_OFF_BENCHMARK_FAILED on PiC/HermC/OpeC/KiloC.
Old GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.7, Mimo V2.5 and DeepSeek Flash defaults are historical and not current leader defaults.
CodoC fixed model is gpt-5.6-sol, not gpt-5.5.
Same-model workers are not interchangeable; benchmark quality and harness reliability differ.
Cost-chain routing is obsolete; route by task fit and benchmark evidence.
CodoC is a high-end worker for judgement, independent audit and high-difficulty development; it is not the default leader.
ClauC is excluded from normal routing order and used only for explicit exceptional T4/scoped work.
The benchmark used one correctness-sensitive idempotency case; low/mid/high risk routing is conservative policy, not independently benchmarked risk-tier evidence.

measurement_policy.capacity_rule: numeric capacity remains unknown/not verified until sufficient homogeneous samples and controlled capacity estimation
measurement_policy.promotion_rule: promote/demote only from homogeneous scorecard evidence; mid/high risk requires independent review
